summary: news-tag Vue component. Props channel (Number|String) and mob; computed newsCates from the store getter newsCates, currentChannel (the cate whose iChanId equals channel) and a fixed color "#BFDB5A". On created, if no categories are cached it runs getCates, an async (asyncToGenerator, module 32 + regeneratorRuntime) call to the news API getCates (module 1124) with sLangKey from store state.lang, committing arrList[0].children via the "setNewsCates" mutation. It renders div.news-tag (mobile class when mob) showing the current channel's sChanName. Normalised with componentNormalizer (module 36); styles from module 1159.
